mentions.name: 50th Symposium Anniversary Book
mentions.description: This commemorative book celebrates the 50th anniversary of the author's symposium, planned as a how-to collection filled with essays from past contributors; the concept is still early and may change since work just started.
mentions.source_excerpt: Just started working on a book to celebrate the 50th year of our symposium, which is coming up in 5 years. The initial idea is a how-to book, filled with essays from past contributors
